title: Zephyrine and the Colony
author: Quentin Okonkwo
blurb: Ivo Sterling, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
